div.head: III Atr 4.2
div.ab: Et si agenfria uenire nolit ad ordalium uidendum, reddat uiginti oras et perdat placitum suum; et ille tamen eat landesrico (id est terre domino) ad ordalium uel reddat duplum.
And gif se ágena frígia nelle þæt ordal gesecean, gilde XX óran, ⁊ sy his spæce forlóren; ⁊ he þeah gange þam landrícan to ordale oððe agife twygilde.
And gif se ágena frígia nelle þæt ordal gesecean, gilde XX óran ⁊ sy his spæce forlóren; ⁊ he þeah gange þam landrícan to ordale oððe agife twygilde.

But if the owner [of the goods] shall fail to appear at the ordeal, he shall pay 20 ores and shall lose his case. But nevertheless the lord of the manor shall cause him (the thief) to go to the ordeal or to pay double the value of the goods.
And if the owner will not attend the ordeal, he is to pay 20 ores, and his suit shall be lost; and yet he [the accused] is to go to the ordeal for the lord of the estate, or to pay two-fold.

Und wenn der Eigenthümer zum Ordal [als Kläger] zu kommen unterlässt, büsse er [dem Herrn] 20 Ör, und sei seine Klage verloren; und jener schreite dennoch für den Immunitätsherrn zum Ordal oder zahle [diesem] doppelt [den gestohlenen Werth].

And if the owner fails to come to the ordeal [as plaintiff], let him pay [the lord] 20 ores, and let his suit be lost; and let that [accused] nevertheless go to the ordeal on behalf of the lord of the immunity, or pay [him] double [the stolen value].
